subject: Staff College Backgrounds and Advice
overview: This student-led broadcast featured Medford High School staff discussing their collegiate experiences and offering guidance to seniors. The program also included a showcase of Halloween costumes from across the school community.

items.title: Halloween Costume Showcase
items.summary: Staff and students displayed various costumes and shared holiday greetings.

items.title: Staff Academic Backgrounds
items.summary: Numerous faculty members listed the undergraduate and graduate institutions they attended across the country.

items.title: Collegiate Memories and Activities
items.summary: Speakers recounted notable experiences from their college years, such as performing at a presidential inauguration, participating in campus media, and meeting spouses.

items.title: Guidance for College Applicants
items.summary: Staff advised current students on selecting colleges based on size and location, conducting campus tours, and using college as a time for exploration rather than immediate specialization.
